text: Moving on to the next slide, I would like to provide an update on our Pest Control and Cleanroom businesses, which remain high-growth and high-margin activities within the group. [#128](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-128)

We operate in a structurally growing clean room market at plus 5% to plus 7% per annum, driven by pharma, biotech and semiconductor investments. [#85](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-85)
Let me highlight two of our fastest growing activities. [#83](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-83)
Cleanroom services are available in 21 countries and Pest Control services in 13 countries. [#139](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-139)

Growth was broad-based across all geographies where the service is deployed and solid execution by our dedicated pest control team supported continued expansion. [#89](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-89)

We are closing it through several levers: increasing network density; expanding our offer to smaller customers as scale improves; and rolling out additional services such as pest control and cleanroom activities, which benefit from strong structural hygiene trends. [#75](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-75)
I will start with Pest Control. [#675](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-675)

Strong momentum in Workwear continued driven by the acceleration in outsourcing, and we recorded additional cross-selling successes in pest control and clean room. [#50](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-50)
Clean room posted plus 6% revenue growth in H1, reaching EUR 145 million, supported by favorable market drivers. [#84](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-84)
Pest Control posted plus 16% volume growth in H1, reaching EUR 45 million. [#88](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-88)
And also in terms of the like-for-like growth, how much of that was cross-selling versus kind of stand-alone Pest Control sales? [#668](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-668)
We are also targeting specific growth pockets, for example, resident [ cleaning ] services in the U.K. [#76](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-76)

But it is -- at the end, it is a good mix between cross-selling with existing customers and opening of new accounts, thanks to Pest Control. [#685](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-685)
Pest Control grew by approximately 9% to reach around EUR 80 million in revenue. [#133](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-133)
Firstly, just on Pest Control, you talked about the 2.5% loss rate improvement. [#666](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-666)

Cleanroom delivered plus 8.5% top line growth to EUR 275 million with robust commercial momentum despite a slightly more constrained client spending environment. [#129](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-129)

First of all, the COVID pandemic, as well as the many safety standards over the last decade, especially in food industry, have resulted in a higher demand for hygiene and protective equipment for workers. [#56](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-56)

Our growing network of regional technical centers and sales representatives is driving growth ahead of the overall market in a highly fragmented industry. [#90](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-90)
We have been able to be super active, and we have transferred all the volume in other plants. [#443](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-443)

So we are close to roll out now these new tools everywhere, and it is part of the productivity program that we have at the group level. [#722](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-722)
